keyPoints.en: Mammals (tiger, elephant, tapir, orang utan), birds (hornbill), reptiles (turtles, crocodiles), insects (Rajah Brooke). The Sumatran rhino is extinct in Malaysia.
keyPoints.bm: Mamalia (harimau, gajah, tapir, orang utan), burung (enggang), reptilia (penyu, buaya), serangga (Raja Brooke). Badak sumbu Sumatera telah pupus di Malaysia.

keyPoints.en: Ecological balance and food chains, seed dispersal, eco-tourism income, research and medicine, natural heritage.
keyPoints.bm: Keseimbangan ekologi dan rantai makanan, penyebaran biji benih, pendapatan eko-pelancongan, penyelidikan dan perubatan, warisan semula jadi.

keyPoints.en: Habitat loss (logging, agriculture, development), poaching and illegal trade, roads splitting habitats, pollution.
keyPoints.bm: Kehilangan habitat (pembalakan, pertanian, pembangunan), pemburuan dan perdagangan haram, jalan raya memecah habitat, pencemaran.

keyPoints.en: Laws (Wildlife Conservation Act 2010), PERHILITAN patrols, national parks (Taman Negara, Kinabalu, Mulu), centres (Sepilok, Kuala Gandah), turtle hatcheries, awareness campaigns.
keyPoints.bm: Undang-undang (Akta Pemuliharaan Hidupan Liar 2010), rondaan PERHILITAN, taman negara (Taman Negara, Kinabalu, Mulu), pusat (Sepilok, Kuala Gandah), tempat penetasan penyu, kempen kesedaran.

tip.en: Preservation = keep untouched; conservation = manage and restore.
tip.bm: Pemeliharaan = kekalkan; pemuliharaan = urus dan pulihkan.
